name: 01 - Pingoo Video Telegram Bot
description: Telegram command entry point for Editing-Pingoo

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  video_subject: $json.video_subject,
  video_script: $json.video_script,

  video_source: "pexels",
  video_terms:
    Array.isArray($json.video_terms) && $json.video_terms.length
      ? $json.video_terms
      : [$json.video_subject],

  scene_manifest:
    Array.isArray($json.scene_manifest)
      ? $json.scene_manifest
      : [],

  supplemental_materials:
    Array.isArray($json.supplemental_materials)
      ? $json.supplemental_materials
      : [],

  flow_materials:
    Array.isArray($json.flow_materials)
      ? $json.flow_materials
      : [],

  material_source_mode:
    $json.material_source_mode || "auto",

  video_language: $json.video_language,
  voice_name: $json.voice_name,
  video_aspect: $json.video_aspect,

  font_name: "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf",

  subtitle_enabled: true,
  subtitle_position: "custom",
  custom_position: 78,
  font_size: 54,

  video_clip_duration: 4,
  match_materials_to_script: true,

  bgm_type: "none",
  video_count: 1
}) }}
